tei:div.tei:p: )༄༅// rnam dag bde chen zhing gi smon lam bzhugs so//

oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ 'di nyid chag med thugs dam mdzod// lag pa na yang 'bad nas bris// mang po 'ga' la e phan bsam// dpe gcod 'dod mi gda' na g.yor// 'di las phan yon che ba med// 'di las zab pa'i gdams pa med// nga yi chos kyi rtsa ba yin// rang gar ma bskyur nyams len 'bung*// 'di ni mdo lugs yin pa'i phyir// lung ma thob kyang 'don ni rung*// e ma ho/ 'di nas nyi ma nub kyi phyogs rol na// grangs med 'jig rten mang po'i pha rol na// cung zad steng du 'phags pa'i yul sa na// rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can// bdag gi chu bur mig gis ma mthong yang*// rang sems gsal ba'i yid la lam mer gsal// de na bcom ldan rgyal ba 'od dpag med// pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can gzi brjid 'bar// dbu la gtsug tor zhabs la 'khor lo sogs// mtshan bzang so gnyis dpe byad brgyad cus spras// zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag lhung bzed 'dzin// chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing skyil krung gis// pad+ma stong ldan zla ba'i gdan steng du// byang chub shing la sku rgyab brten mdzad de// thugs rje'i spyan gyis rgyang nas bdag la gzigs// g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs// sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yon pad dkar 'dzin// g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob// sngon po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pad+ma g.yon// g.yas gnyis skyabs sbyin phyag rgya bdag la bstan// gtso bo gsum po ri rgyal lhun po bzhin// lhang nge lhan ne lham mer bzhugs pa'i 'khor// byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong bye ba 'bum// kun kyang gser mdog mtshan dang dpe byad brgyan// chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing ser ltem me// mos gus phyag la nye ring khyad med phyir// bdag gis sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// chos sku snang ba mtha' yas rigs kyi bdag /phyag g.yas 'od zer las sprul spyan ras gzigs// yang sprul spyan ras gzigs dbang bye ba brgya// phyag g.yon 'od zer las sprul sgrol ma ste// yang sprul sgrol ma bye ba phrag brgya 'gyed// thugs kyi 'od zer las sprul pad+ma 'byung*// yang sprul o rgyan bye ba phrag brgya 'gyed// chos sku 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas spyan gyis nyin mtshan dus drug tu// sems can kun la brtse bas rtag tu gzigs// sems can kun gyi yid la gang dran pa'i// rnam rtog gang 'gyu rtag tu thugs kyis mkhyen// sems can kun gyis ngag tu gang smras tshig

/rtag tu ma 'dres so sor snyan la gsan// kun mkhyen 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// chos spangs mtshams med byas pa ma gtogs pa// khyed la dad cing smon lam btab tshad kun// bde ba can der skye ba'i smon lam grub// bar dor byon nas zhing der 'dren par gsungs// 'dren pa 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed kyi sku tshe bskal pa grangs med du// mya ngan mi 'da' da lta mngon sum bzhugs// khyed la rtse gcig gus pas gsol btab na// las kyi rnam par smin pa ma gtogs pa'i// tshe zad pa yang lo brgya thub pa dang*// dus min 'chi ba ma lus bzlog par gsungs// mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams grangs med pa// rin chen gyis bkang sbyin pa byin pa bas// 'od dpag med pa'i mtshan dang bde ba can// thos nas dad pas thal mo sbyar byas na// de ni de bas bsod nams che bar gsungs// de phyir 'od dpag med la gus phyag 'tshal// gang zhig 'od dpag med pa'i mtshan thos nas// kha zhe med par snying khong rus pa'i gting*// lan gcig tsam zhig dad pa skyes pa na// de ni byang chub lam las phyir mi ldog /mgon po 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i mtshan thos nas// de ni byang chub snying po ma thob bar// bud med mi skye rigs ni bzang por skye// tshe rabs kun tu tshul khrims rnam dag 'gyur// bde gshegs 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dge rtsar bcas// dngos su 'byor ba'i mchod pa ci mchis pa// yid sprul bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun// gdod nas grub pa stong gsum 'jig rten gyi// gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla bye ba brgya// lha klu mi yi longs spyod thams cad kun// blo yis blangs te 'od dpag med la 'bul// bdag la phan phyir thugs rje'i stobs kyis bzhes// pha mas thog drangs bdag sogs 'gro kun gyis// thog ma med pa'i dus nas da lta'i bar// srog bcad ma byin blangs dang mi tshangs spyod// lus kyi mi dge gsum po mthol lo bshags// rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal ba// ngag gi mi dge bzhi po mthol lo bshags// brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba ste// yid kyi mi dge gsum po mthol lo bshags// pha ma slob dpon dgra bcom bsad pa dang*// rgyal ba'i sku la ngan sems skyes pa dang*// mtshams med lnga yi las bsags mthol=

dge slong dge tshul bsad dang btsun ma phab// sku gzugs mchod rten lha khang bshigs la sogs// nye ba'i mtshams med sdig byas mthol lo bshags// dkon mchog lha khang gsung rab rten gsum sogs// dpang zhes tshad btsugs mna' zos la sogs pa// chos spangs las ngan bsags pa mthol lo bshags// khams gsum sems can bsad las sdig che ba// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la skur pa btab// don med sdig chen bsags pa mthol lo bshags// dge ba'i phan yon sdig pa'i nyes dmigs dang*// dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal tshe tshad la sogs pa// thos kyang mi bden bshad tshod yin bsam pa// mtshams med lnga bas thu ba'i las ngan pa// thar med las ngan bsags pa mthol lo bshags// pham pa bzhi dang lhag ma bcu gsum dang*// spang ltung sor bshags nyes byas sde tshan lnga// so thar tshul khrims 'chal ba mthol lo bshags// nag po'i chos bzhi ltung ba lnga lnga brgyad// byang sems bslab pa nyams pa mthol lo bshags// rtsa ltung bcu bzhi yan lag sbom po brgyad// gsang sngags dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags// sdom pa ma zhus mi dge'i las byas pa// mi tshangs spyod dang chang 'thung la sogs pa// rang bzhin kha na ma tho'i sdig pa ste// sdig pa sdig tu ma shes mthol lo bshags// skyabs sdom dbang bskur la sogs thob na yang*// de yi sdom pa dam tshig bsrung ma shes// bcas pa'i ltung ba phog pa mthol lo bshags// 'gyod pa med na bshags pas mi 'dag pas// sngar byas sdig pa khong du dug song ltar// ngo tsha 'jigs skrag 'gyod pa chen pos bshags// phyin chad sdom sems med na mi 'dag pas// phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi dge'i las// da nas mi bgyid sems la dam bca' bzung*// bde gshegs 'od dpag med pa sras bcas kyis// bdag rgyud yongs su dag par byin gyis rlobs// gzhan gyis dge ba byed pa thos pa'i tshe// de la phrag dog me dge'i sems spangs nas// snying nas dga' bas rjes su yi rang na// de yi bsod nams mnyam du thob par gsungs// de phyir 'phags pa rnams dang so skye yis// dge ba gang bsgrub kun la yi rang ngo*// bla med byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// 'gro don rgya chen mdzad la yi rang ngo*// mi dge bcu po spangs pa dge ba bcu// gzhan gyi srog bskyab sbyin pa gtong ba dang*// sdom pa srung zhing bden par smra ba dang*// 'khon pa sdum dang zhi dul drang por smra// don dang ldan pa'i gtam brjod 'dod pa chung*// byams dang snying rje sgom zhing chos la spyod// dge ba de rnams kun la yi rang ngo*// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams thams cad na// rdzogs sangs rgyas nas ring por ma lon pa// de dag rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo ni// rgya chen myur du bskor bar bdag gis bskul// mngon shes thugs kyis de don mkhyen par gsol// sangs rgyas byang sems bstan 'dzin dge ba'i bshes// mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed kun de dag la// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// 'dis mtshon bdag gi dus gsum dge ba rnams// 'gro ba sems can kun gyi don du bsngo// kun kyang bla med byang chub myur thob nas// khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs gyur cig

/de yi dge ba bdag la myur smin nas// tshe 'dir dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad zhi// nad med lang tsho rgyas pa'i lus stobs ldan// dpal 'byor 'dzad med dbyar gyi gaṅga ltar// bdud dgra'i 'tshe ba med cing dam chos spyod// bsam pa'i don kun chos ldan yid bzhin 'grub// bstan dang 'gro la phan thogs rgya chen 'grub// mi lus don dang ldan pa 'grub par shog /bdag dang bdag la 'brel thogs kun// 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /sprul pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med// dge slong dge 'dun 'khor gyis bskor// mdun du mngon sum 'byon par shog /de mthong yid dga' snang ba skyid// shi ba'i sdug bsngal med par shog /byang chub sems dpa' mched brgyad ni// rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis nam mkhar byon// bde ba can du 'gro ba yi// lam ston lam sna 'dren par shog /ngan song sdug bsngal bzod blag med// lha mi'i bde skyid mi rtag 'gyur// de la skrag sems skye bar shog /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// 'khor ba 'di na yun re ring*// de la skyo ba skye bar shog /mi nas mi ru skye chog kyang*// skye rga na 'chi grangs med myong*// dus ngan snyigs mar bar chad mang*// mi dang lha yi bde skyid 'di// dug dang 'dres pa'i zas bzhin du// 'dod pa spu tsam med par shog /nye du zas nor mthun grogs rnams// mi rtag sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin// chags zhen spu tsam med par shog /sa cha yul ris khang khyim rnams// rmi lam yul gyi khang khyim ltar// bden par ma grub shes par shog /thar med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nas// nyes chen btson nas thar ba bzhin// bde ba can gyi zhing khams su// phyi ltas med par 'bros par shog /chags zhen 'khri ba kun bcad nas// bya rgod rnyi nas thar ba bzhin// nub kyi phyogs kyi nam mkha' la// 'jig rten khams ni grangs med pa// skad cig yud la bgrod byas nas// bde ba can du phyin par shog

/de ru sangs rgyas 'od dpag med// mngon sum bzhugs pa'i zhal mthong nas// sgrib pa thams cad dag par shog /skye gnas bzhi yi mchog gyur pa// me tog pad+ma'i snying po la// brdzus te skye ba len par shog /skad cig nyid la lus rdzogs nas// mtshan dpe ldan pa'i lus thob shog /mi skye dogs pa'i the tshom gyis// lo grangs lnga brgya'i bar dag tu// nang der bde skyid longs spyod ldan// sangs rgyas gsung ni thos na yang*// me tog kha ni mi bye bas// sangs rgyas zhal mjal phyi ba'i skyon// de 'dra bdag la mi 'byung shog /skyes ma thag tu me tog bye// 'od dpag med pa'i zhal mthong shog /bsod nams stobs dang rdzu 'phrul gyis// lag pa'i mthil nas mchod pa'i sprin// bsam mi khyab par spros byas nas// sangs rgyas 'khor bcas mchod par shog /de tshe de bzhin gshegs pa des// phyag g.yas brkyang nas mgo la bzhag /byang chub lung bstan thob par shog /zab dang rgya che'i chos thos nas// rang rgyud smin cing grol bar shog /spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob// rgyal sras thu bo rnam gnyis kyis// byin gyis brlabs shing rjes bzung shog /nyin re bzhin du phyogs bcu yi// sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med pa// 'od dpag med pa mchod pa dang*// zhing der blta phyir 'byon pa'i tshe// de dag kun la bsnyen bkur zhing*// chos kyi bdud rtsi thob par shog /rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa yis// mngon dga'i zhing dang dpal ldan zhing*// las rab rdzogs dang stug po bkod// snga dro de dag rnams su 'gro// mi bskyod rin 'byung don yod grub// rnam snang la sogs sangs rgyas la// dbang dang byin rlabs sdom pa zhu// mchod pa du mas mchod byas nas// dgong mo bde ba can nyid du// dka' tshegs med par sleb par shog /po ṭa la dang lcang lo can// rnga yab gling dang o rgyan yul// sprul sku'i zhing khams bye ba brgyar// spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma dang*// phyag rdor pad 'byung bye ba brgya// mjal zhing mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod// dbang dang gdams ngag zab mo zhu// myur du rang gnas bde chen zhing*// thogs pa med par phyin par shog

/shul gyi nye du grwa slob sogs// lha yi mig gis gsal bar mthong*// srung skyob byin gyis rlob byed cing*// 'chi dus zhing der khrid par shog /bskal bzang 'di yi bskal pa'i yun// bde ba can gyi zhag gcig ste// bskal pa grangs med 'chi ba med// rtag tu zhing de 'dzin par shog /byams pa nas bzung mos pa'i bar// bskal bzang 'di yi sangs rgyas rnams// 'jig rten 'di na nam 'byon tshe// rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis 'dir 'ongs nas// sangs rgyas mchod cing dam chos nyan// slar yang bde chen zhing khams su// thogs pa med par 'gro bar shog /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag /brgyad cu rtsa gcig sangs rgyas zhing kun gyi// yon tan bkod pa thams cad gcig bsdoms pa// zhing khams kun las khyad 'phags bla na med// bde ba can gyi zhing der skye bar shog /rin chen sa gzhi khod snyoms lag mthil ltar// yangs shing rgya che gsal zhing 'od zer 'bar// mnan na nem zhing btegs na spar byed pa// bde 'jam yangs pa'i zhing der skye bar shog /rin chen du ma las grub dpag bsam shing*// lo ma dar zab 'bras bu rin chen brgyan// de steng sprul pa'i bya tshogs skad snyan sgras// zab dang rgya che'i chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs// ngo mtshar chen po'i zhing der skye bar shog /spos chu'i chu klung yan lag brgyad ldan mang*// de bzhin bdud rtsi'i khrus kyi rdzing bu rnams// rin chen sna bdun them skas pha gus bskor// me tog pad+ma dri zhim 'bras bur ldan// pad+ma'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro// 'od zer rtse la sprul pa'i sangs rgyas brgyan// ya mtshan chen po'i zhing der skye bar shog /mi khom brgyad dang ngan song sgra mi grags// nyon mongs dug lnga dug gsum nad dang gdon// dgra dang dbul phongs 'thab rtsod la sogs pa// sdug bsngal thams cad zhing der thos ma myong*// bde ba chen po'i zhing der skye bar shog

/bud med med cing mngal nas skye ba med// kun kyang me tog pad+ma'i sbubs nas 'khrungs// thams cad sku lus khyad med gser gyi mdog /dbu la gtsug gtor la sogs mtshan dpes brgyan// mngon shes lnga dang spyan lnga kun la mnga'// yon tan dpag med zhing der skye bar shog /rang byung rin chen sna tshogs gzhal yas khang*// ci 'dod longs spyod yid la dran pas 'byung*// rtsol sgrub mi dgos dgos 'dod lhun gyis grub// nga khyod med cing bdag tu 'dzin pa med// gang 'dod mchod sprin lag pa'i mthil nas 'byung*// thams cad bla med theg chen chos la spyod// bde skyid kun 'byung zhing der skye bar shog /dri zhim rlung gis me tog char chen 'bebs// shing dang chu klung pad+mo thams cad las// yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg /longs spyod mchod pa'i sprin phung rtag tu 'byung*// bud med med kyang sprul pa'i lha mo'i tshogs// mchod pa'i lha mo du mas rtag tu mchod// 'dug par 'dod tshe rin chen gzhal yas khang*// nyal bar 'dod tshe rin chen khri bzang steng*// dar zab du ma'i mal stan sngas dang bcas// bya dang ljon shing chu klung rol mo sogs// thos par 'dod na snyan pa'i chos sgra sgrogs// mi 'dod tshe na rna bar sgra mi grags// bdud rtsi'i rdzing bu chu klung de rnams kyang*// dro grang gang 'dod de la de ltar 'byung*// yid bzhin 'grub pa'i zhing der skye bar shog /zhing der rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med// bskal pa grangs med mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs// de srid de yi zhabs 'bring byed par shog /nam zhig 'od dpag med de zhi bar gshegs// bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed// gnyis kyi bar du bstan pa gnas pa'i tshe// rgyal tshab spyan ras gzigs dang mi 'bral zhing*// de yi yun la dam chos 'dzin par shog /srod la dam chos nub pa'i tho rangs la// spyan ras gzigs de mngon par sangs rgyas nas// sangs rgyas 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa yi// dpal brtsegs rgyal po zhes byar gyur pa'i tshe// zhal ta mchod cing dam chos nyan par shog

/sku tshe bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig ni// 'bum phrag dgu cu rtsa drug bzhugs pa'i tshe// rtag tu zhabs 'bring bsnyen bkur byed pa dang*// mi brjed gzungs kyis dam chos 'dzin par shog /mya ngan 'das nas de yi bstan pa ni// bskal pa dung phyur drug dang bye ba phrag /'bum phrag gsum gnas de tshe chos 'dzin cing*// mthu chen thob dang rtag tu mi 'bral shog /de nas mthu chen thob de sangs rgyas nas// de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu brtan pa ni// yon tan nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal por gyur// sku tshe bstan pa spyan ras gzigs dang mnyam// sangs rgyas de yi rtag tu zhabs 'bring byed// mchod pas mchod cing dam chos kun 'dzin shog /de nas bdag gi tshe de brjes ma thag /zhing khams de'am dag pa'i zhing gzhan du// bla med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /rdzogs sangs rgyas nas tshe dpag med pa ltar// mtshan thos tsam gyis 'gro kun smin cing grol// sprul pa grangs med 'gro ba 'dren pa sogs// 'bad med lhun grub 'gro don dpag med shog /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dang*// yon tan ye shes gzi brjid tshad med pa// chos sku snang ba mtha' yas 'od dpag med// tshe dang ye shes dpag med bcom ldan 'das// gang zhig khyed kyi mtshan ni sus 'dzin pa// sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin ma gtogs pa// me chu dug mtshon gnod sbyin srin po sogs// 'jigs pa kun las skyob par thub pas gsungs// bdag ni khyed kyi mtshan 'dzin phyag 'tshal bas// 'jigs dang sdug bsngal kun las bskyab mdzad gsol// bkra shis phun sum tshogs par byin gyis rlobs// sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*// chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// dge 'dun mi phyed 'dun pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ji ltar smon lam btab bzhin 'grub par shog /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// tad+ya tha/
pañci dri ya a wa bo dha na ye swā hā/

smon lam 'grub pa'i gzungs so// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo mañju shri ye/ na moḥsu shri ye/ na mo ut+ta ma shri ye swā hā/ zhes brjod nas phyag gsum 'tshal na 'bum ther du 'gyur bar gsungs/ de nas rab brgya phrag /'bring ci nus/ tha ma yang phyag bdun yan 'tshal/ rab 'di ma chag pa/ 'bring lo zla tsam ma chag pa/ tha ma nam khom skabs su kha nub tu gyu nas bde ba can gyi zhing khams yid la dran cing 'od dpag med la thal mo sbyar te dad pa rtse gcig gis bton na/ tshe 'dir tshe'i bar chad sel/ phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar the tshom med do// 'od mdo zhing bkod mdo dang*/ pad+ma dkar po 'chi med rnga sgra sogs kyi dgongs pa yin/ zhes dge slong rā ga a s+yas sbyar bas 'gro ba sems can mang po bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyur gyur cig ༈/ smon lan bsdus pa ni/ e ma hoḥ ngo mtshar sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang : g.yas su jo bo thugs rje chen po dang : g.yon du sems dpa' mthu chen thob rnams la: sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med 'khor gyis bskor: bde skyid ngo mtshar dpag tu med pa yi: bde ba can zhes bya ba'i zhing khams der: bdag ni 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa ru: de ru skyes nas snang mtha'i zhal mthong shog: de skad bdag gis smon lam btab pa 'di: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis: gegs med 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol: tad+yathā/ pañci dri ya a wa bo dha na ye swā hā: zhes pa 'di ni sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum gser 'phyang gi lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes bdun la gtso 'khor rnams kyis zhal gzigs pa'i tshe sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyis dngos su gsungs pa'o// ༈ phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs: tshogs gnyis rdzogs la rjes yi rang : bdag gis dus gsum dge bsags pa: dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa 'bul:

rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel gyur cig: dge ba sems can kun la bsngo: 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob gyur cig: dge rtsa thams cad gcig bsdus te: bdag gi rgyud la smin gyur cig: sgrib gnyis dag nas tshogs rdzogs te: tshe ring nad med nyams rtogs 'phel: tshe 'dir sa bcu non gyur cig: nam zhig tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: bde ba can du skye gyur cig: skyes nas pad+mo kha bye ste: lus rten de la sangs rgyas shog: byang chub thob nas ji srid du: sprul pas 'gro ba 'dra ེna par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ces pa 'di ni sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gter ma'o// dge'o/// /
